cardOverview.overviewText: An upgraded MoneyBack Plus version delivering higher cashback rates, milestone rewards, and better lifestyle perks for everyday spenders.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Upto 10% off on dining at over 2000 premium restaurants.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% savings at 20,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC MoneyBack Plus credit card to unlock the offer.
